title: Europa League top scorers 2010/11 to 2019/20
brief: Name the top scorer (or a joint top scorer) in the UEFA Cup or Europa League each season from 2010/11 to 2019/20.
period: UEFA Cup and Europa League seasons 2010/11 to 2019/20, main competition only

rows.name: Alan
rows.val: 8 goals, shared: Alan (Red Bull Salzburg), Romelu Lukaku (Everton)

rows.name: Aritz Aduriz
rows.val: 8 goals, shared: Aritz Aduriz (Athletic Bilbao), Ciro Immobile (Lazio)

notes.Fernando Llorente: Fernando Llorente never topped a season's list.
notes.Klaas-Jan Huntelaar: Klaas-Jan Huntelaar scored 10 in 2011/12, two behind Falcao.
notes.Luka Jovic: Luka Jovic scored 10 in 2018/19, one behind Giroud.

checks: Each season's top scorer from UEFA.com's season goal rankings (main competition only: first round onwards to 2008/09, group or league stage onwards from 2009/10, qualifying and play-offs left out), checked against Transfermarkt's season scorer lists; they agree on every season. Ties are shared rows (alts). Most slots for one player: Aritz Aduriz 2, Radamel Falcao 2, so the 4-slot rule passes.
